rule: Test decisions and artifacts, not runtime vocabulary. Keep a case only when it represents a distinct recurring failure mechanism.

regressions.prompt: Crie a marca deste produto.
regressions.setup: Product/site evidence is available, but private future strategy is not.
judge: Inspect available reality and construct the smallest useful brief before asking the user to restate discoverable information or inventing facts.
Ask only for missing truth, authority or founder signal that can materially change the work; otherwise make the professional decision according to the collaboration mode.
An explicit request to decide everything reduces preference gates but never authorizes invented private/future truth or unowned external authority.

regressions.prompt: Formalize nossa marca atual e modernize o que precisar.
regressions.setup: The identity has years of coherent use but no canonical spec; no material failure is established.
judge: Reconstruct and preserve useful equity before changing it.
Treat missing documentation as a documentation gap, not a redesign trigger.

regressions.prompt: Explore direções para a identidade e recomende uma.
regressions.setup: Strategy is established; the category has an obvious competent default, and the first plausible lineages are formally different but remain clustered around the category vocabulary and one familiar family of mechanisms.
judge: Build a small decision-changing reference field that exposes the category default, a real craft bar and useful outside mechanisms; references are decomposed rather than copied.

Treat the lineages as a search portfolio: generate materially different governing ideas, then detect material conceptual clustering and deliberately open a distant search region before convergence when coverage remains narrow.

Allow remote provocations to begin without semantic grounding; extract their transferable mechanism first, then require a legitimate bridge to true, particular brand material before they can survive art direction.
Commit through grounding, relevance, evident logic, distinction, generative potential and the named bar, neither category autocomplete, arbitrary novelty nor reflexive opposition.

regressions.prompt: Finalize a identidade.
regressions.setup: The chosen direction looks strong in presentation but repeated legitimate applications need exceptions and lose specificity.
judge: Treat repeated use failure as evidence about the system or direction, not a reason to keep patching artifacts.
Correct the lowest layer that explains the defect and re-test.

regressions.prompt: O spec validou e os mockups estão ótimos; confirme que a marca é memorável e está pronta.
regressions.setup: Structural checks pass; no audience study exists and real applications remain under-resolved.
judge: Reject structural completeness and polish as proof of creative or market outcomes.
Use the evidence class capable of answering each material question and leave unavailable external claims unresolved.

regressions.prompt: Finalize o logo expressivo.
regressions.setup: Only a polished raster concept can be produced and inspected; no trustworthy vector master path exists.
judge: Preserve the creative concept while reporting the actual production state.
Do not promote appearance or file validity into production proof.

regressions.prompt: Finalize a identidade e entregue o logo, duas aplicações e o brand book.
regressions.setup: The direction and system are resolved. The host exposes adequate vector/design-canvas and layout/export capabilities. No central generated imagery is required.
judge: Use appropriate production surfaces to create the actual material visual artifacts instead of stopping at descriptions, prompts, guidelines or mockup concepts.
Render/view and refine the artifacts before completion; keep production masters/source distinct from contextual mockups and structural validity.

regressions.prompt: Use o gerador disponível para produzir a key visual aprovada e refine o primeiro resultado, que ficou muito genérico e com a luz errada.
regressions.setup: A resolved art-direction packet and suitable generation backend exist. Current provider/model guidance is available. The first output preserves the subject and composition but loses brand-specific material behavior and lighting.
judge: Compile the resolved direction for the actual generation mode, using current provider-native guidance when available without inventing a new aesthetic or generic quality language to replace missing decisions.
Diagnose the near-miss and change the smallest causal request input/reference/control while preserving successful parts of the result instead of globally rewriting the request.

regressions.prompt: A direção aprovada depende de uma série de fotografias autorais. Finalize a identidade com o que tiver disponível.
regressions.setup: No official FLUX capability is connected. The host exposes only a low-quality generic image generator that cannot preserve the selected direction.
judge: Do not weaken the committed direction or silently accept inferior imagery merely to finish.
Request the appropriate FLUX connection/configuration or report the affected production as blocked; use a fallback only if it can independently meet the same quality bar.

regressions.prompt: O FLUX não está disponível neste ambiente. Finalize a série com o gerador que existe aqui.
regressions.setup: The current environment has no supported FLUX path, and the available generator can preserve the approved direction at the required quality.
judge: Use the available generator rather than blocking solely because FLUX is unavailable.
Keep the same art-direction, integration and completion gates.

regressions.prompt: O FLUX gerou esta imagem cinematográfica incrível para a campanha. Pode fechar a direção visual.
regressions.setup: The image is highly polished but its subject, composition and aesthetic could serve many unrelated brands in the category.
judge: Reject visual spectacle as proof of brand relevance or specificity.
Refine the art direction and asset until consequential choices depend causally on this brand and its job.

regressions.prompt: A key visual já ficou ótima no gerador. Finalize a aplicação e o brand book.
regressions.setup: The image has not been persisted into the working project, integrated into representative applications, or inspected with the identity in context.
judge: Treat generation as an intermediate production state, not completion.
Persist, integrate, render/inspect in representative use and refine before claiming the application or brand book is final.

regressions.prompt: Faça mais cinco imagens no mesmo universo da key visual aprovada.
regressions.setup: Each generated image is individually strong, but the set drifts in lighting, materiality, framing and stylization until it resembles unrelated campaigns.
judge: Use the approved imagery grammar and reference-driven continuation/editing to preserve family resemblance while allowing range.
Treat a set of unrelated visual successes as an unresolved image system rather than a completed brand asset library.

regressions.prompt: Crie a marca desta padaria e entregue o manual.
regressions.setup: Render capability exists and the owner is reachable. Nothing prevents building immediately after choosing a direction.
judge: In the default recommend-and-ratify mode, direction candidates reach the owner as rendered, comparable boards with a recommendation before the system is built; a written rationale alone is not a direction.

If the owner explicitly delegates creative commitments, the studio may choose the strongest proven direction and continue without a preference gate, while truth and authority boundaries remain intact.

regressions.prompt: Teste o sistema em uso e finalize.
regressions.setup: meta.touchpoints declares apron, packaging, storefront window, presentation deck and social feed. A browser is the most convenient render surface.
judge: Each declared touchpoint is rendered in the context where it lives, or reported as a named gap with a lowered maturity label.
Convenient substitute mockups on the measuring surface do not count as having seen the touchpoint.

regressions.prompt: Na verdade não é reconstruir o material anexo; você é o designer, quero o branding completo.
regressions.setup: The session began as a reconstruction of an existing undocumented identity and has already systematized part of it.
judge: The reframe re-routes to CREATE and reopens DIVERGE with rendered boards instead of continuing to systematize the inherited material.

regressions.prompt: Entregue o manual da marca.
regressions.setup: strategy.audience.language is pt-BR; book.readers are a designer, a printer and a kitchen coordinator with no design training, all reading pt-BR, each with two to six tasks. The repository's own conventions are in English.
judge: The book is a working document in its readers' language, organized around the readers' tasks, in the fixed structure and section unit of brand-book.md, with brand copy examples in the audience's language inside example elements, and without process vocabulary leaking into the artifact.
A reader who did not participate can orient, find an exact rule or asset and apply a representative rule without the maker explaining the interface.
The book has been rendered and inspected in every medium it claims to serve, including representative screen sizes and print.

regressions.prompt: Persista o estado da marca.
regressions.setup: During refinement three fixes were rejected and one color was renamed twice. The contextual renders were produced by compositing the vector master over generated scenes.
judge: brand-spec.json records only what is in force: no evidence table, statuses, rejected fixes, renames or open questions; provenance appears only as a one-sentence basis on the clause that needs it.
Any clause about renders states the acceptance criterion (the drawn mark is the master, verified against it) and not the production technique (compositing).
Pending matters go to the delivery report, and the contract is not placed in a publicly served directory by default.

regressions.prompt: Coloque as novas fotos das simulações no manual.
regressions.setup: Six physical touchpoints are declared. The generated scenes are photographically stronger than the agent's own composites; in three of them the generator redrew the signature on a curved or textured surface while colors stayed within tolerance.
judge: Each scene's mark is checked against the master at magnification, individually; color tolerance is not accepted as proof that the mark survived.

Where the mark deviates, the scene is kept and the master recomposed into it with the scene's perspective, light and material; the redrawn mark is not accepted and the scene is not discarded for a weaker composite.

regressions.prompt: Entregue.
regressions.setup: All declared touchpoints have a render, but two are flat composites while the rest are photographic scenes; every file count, reference and structural check reconciles.
judge: The operator report names each declared touchpoint with its maturity label, so the two lower-maturity pieces are visible without being asked for.
Counts and passing checks are reported as package facts, never as evidence of quality or completion.

regressions.prompt: Finalize o brand book; todas as seções estão consistentes e nenhuma parece pior que as outras.
regressions.setup: Every section is individually competent and internally consistent, but the whole document is dense, difficult to orient, weak for lookup and visibly below the named craft bar. No local component is conspicuously worse than another.
judge: Evaluate the whole document against the absolute book floor before applying the relative weakest-element rule.
Treat failed orientation/retrieval and whole-document weakness as architecture or experience defects rather than polishing arbitrary local components.
Do not call the book final until Transfer, Expression, Integrity and Delivery have evidence appropriate to each property.

regressions.prompt: A assinatura herdada parece boa; aplique em todos os materiais e finalize a identidade.
regressions.setup: The inherited lockup is recognizable and technically valid, but its critical spacing and optical balance have not been compared or resolved. Propagating it now would put the same decision into many applications.
judge: Resolve and inspect the critical master before it fans out into applications; preservation and file validity are not craft proof.
When the optical relationship is ambiguous, compare a small set of credible alternatives at relevant sizes and conditions before choosing.
Do not impose a universal geometric derivation when deliberate optical correction performs better and remains reproducible.

regressions.prompt: Feche o manual e entregue.
regressions.setup: Six declared touchpoints have renders. Five are strong. One is compliant (colors within tolerance, mark drawn correctly) but carries a visible generator defect in a hand and a contact shadow that does not match the light; the agent made it and it fills the last slot in the book.
judge: Judge the whole package against the relevant absolute floor before ranking local elements; a uniformly weak set does not pass merely because no single element is worse than the others.
Once the floor holds, rank the visible set side by side and raise or remove the weakest admitted render rather than shipping it because it exists or fills a slot.
If removed, the package is composed without a placeholder and the operator report names the gap at its truthful maturity.

regressions.prompt: Gere o manual da marca.
regressions.setup: The visual system is resolved (grid, type roles, color proportions, image behavior). The host renders HTML; web-default components are the path of least effort.
judge: The book behaves as branded documentation: its information architecture, wayfinding, retrieval and responsive/print behavior serve reader jobs while its visual grammar derives from the brand rather than generic documentation UI.
Before the full book is scaled, a representative prototype containing the document's real tensions is rendered and repaired across the claimed media.
Familiar interface patterns are accepted when their function is needed and their form is resolved through the brand system; novelty is not a substitute for usable navigation.

regressions.prompt: Crie o sistema verbal para um software de manutenção predial que reduz perda de contexto entre turnos. Demonstre homepage, onboarding, aviso de inspeção atrasada e email executivo. Não há evidência de liderança, superioridade ou confiança medida.
judge: Keep proposition and claims bounded by truth/proof while adapting message and expression to each context.
Judge the actual copy: principles should generate specific new language, not merely generic voice adjectives or repeated slogans.

regressions.prompt: Explore três caminhos para a identidade e recomende um.
regressions.setup: Strategy is established. No direction criteria have been written yet; the first instinct is to generate routes and then explain why the preferred one is best.
judge: Direction criteria (perceptions to produce and avoid, confirmable from an artifact) are written in FRAME, before any route exists, and confirmed with the owner in plain language.
Routes are compared against those criteria and against a deliberately produced generic floor; no criterion is added or adjusted after the candidates exist.

regressions.prompt: Monte um painel de juízes, dê notas de 1 a 5 ao logo contra Amazon, FedEx e Nike, e continue até chegar a 4,5.
regressions.setup: An isolated judging context is available. The owner is lay and has asked for a numeric target.
judge: No numeric score, average or ranking-as-measurement is produced or shown; the studio says creative quality cannot be measured this way and names what can (criteria, blind pairwise comparison, audience test).
Global icons are rejected as a bar; the comparison set is the generic floor and two or three in-market identities, judged pairwise, blind, in both orders.
The owner is not asked which one they like and receives a recommendation.

regressions.prompt: Gere folhas de exploração de símbolos para o logo com o gerador disponível.
regressions.setup: The direction is committed with a typographic signature as its signature. The easiest prompts would ask for 'clever symbols with a hidden second reading, award-winning, in the style of Paul Rand'.
judge: Exploration batches state the question they explore (a territory, a lineage, a symbol family) and are made in volume; production requests name the criteria clause they execute.
No quality incantations, designer or studio names, or other brands' devices appear in any request.
Generated sheets are exploration only; nothing generated or 'redrawn as vector' by the generator is treated as a master.

regressions.prompt: A direção escolhida coloca a contadora responsável, com nome e registro, como assinatura da marca. Construa o sistema.
regressions.setup: The owner's documents describe a founder-accountant but never give the name, the registration number, or whether the founder wants to be the face of the brand.
judge: Before anything is built, the studio lists the truths the direction depends on and asks the owner for them with a recommendation.
No invented person, name, registration or portrait appears in any owner-facing render; a placeholder, if used internally, is labeled as one.

regressions.prompt: Os juízes acham que o logo ainda pode melhorar. Reabra a exploração do símbolo.
regressions.setup: The master was proved at critical scales, ratified by the owner and propagated into six applications and contextual scenes. No application has failed in use.
judge: A repeated judgment of the same artifact does not reopen a proved and propagated master; the studio names what would (failure in use, the owner's authority) and refines the judged artifact at most.
If judgments keep pulling toward something the criteria do not describe, the studio raises the criteria or the direction with the owner instead of re-exploring the symbol.

regressions.prompt: Gostei muito do azul, pode seguir com esse.
regressions.setup: The owner is lay. The blue route conflicts with an agreed criterion ('does not read as a digital bank'). No audience evidence exists.
judge: The studio asks one question about what makes the owner feel that, classifies the answer (truth, recognition or taste) and, when it is taste, states the trade-off in business terms with a recommendation.
If the owner still chooses the blue route, the decision is recorded in the report as accepted by the owner, not as proved; the owner's approval does not become evidence about the audience.

regressions.prompt: Preciso só de opções de nome para a empresa, nada de identidade visual por enquanto.
regressions.setup: No contract exists. The full CREATE route would render boards and build a system.
judge: Only the naming subgraph runs, with the client loop; no boards, system, brand book or contextual renders are produced.
The skipped stages are not reported as gaps.

regressions.prompt: Retome o projeto de onde paramos.
regressions.setup: A previous session wrote brand-report.md beside the contract with the direction criteria, three pending truths and touchpoint maturities. Nothing else of the conversation survives.
judge: The studio reads the report before asking the owner anything and states in one line where the project is and what is pending.
The owner is not asked to repeat information the report already holds.

regressions.prompt: Pensei em chamar de Quadra ou algo assim; se precisar mudar, pode mudar. Crie o branding.
regressions.setup: No contract exists. The owner's name is tentative. Cheap triage would find a near-homophone accounting firm in the same city and distribution channel, and the word is a common address term in the market.
judge: The tentative name is treated as a candidate: the naming funnel runs before any card or mark, and the owner's name passes the same filters as the others.
Cheap triage runs on the full shortlist before cards, reports collisions by proximity, and the close collision reaches the owner with a recommendation before anything visual exists.
The owner is told once, with the recommendation, that attachment before triage is the classic failure, and keeps the decision.

regressions.prompt: Gere opções de nome para a empresa.
regressions.setup: Criteria and the market map exist. The easiest output is twenty names clustered around the category vocabulary and the current suffix fads.
judge: The floor is generated first and excluded; candidates come by lineage with a quota per lineage and distinct source domains, including the name of a person or place; the count is of the order of a hundred before filtering.
The generation request is short and unformatted and contains no example names, designers or brands to sound like.
Convergence is countered structurally, not with an instruction to be creative.

regressions.prompt: Já escolhemos o nome; agora faça a checagem legal e siga para o logo.
regressions.setup: The name was chosen from a shortlist that never had cheap triage. Deep triage on the single survivor finds an apparent collision.
judge: The studio does not treat deep triage on one survivor as the first filter; it reopens the shortlist stage with cheap triage on all candidates and reports what the missed stage cost.
No mark is drawn on a name with a close, unresolved collision; the brand stays provisional until the owner resolves it.

regressions.prompt: Desses seis nomes, nenhum soa como a gente. O que soa mais perto é o terceiro, por causa do som curto.
regressions.setup: Round one with the owner. The owner's reaction names a property (short sound), not a favorite.
judge: The reaction is read as evidence about the criteria and reopens generation from the recognized property, within the funnel, rather than being treated as rejection of the shortlist or as a vote.
The owner is not asked which one they prefer; the next round asks again which sound like them and why.

regressions.prompt: Gere o manual da marca.
regressions.setup: The system is resolved and the admitted renders exist. The path of least effort is a single-page site: a hero with the logo and a slogan, a manifesto paragraph, adjectives for the brand personality, and rules written in the brand's own voice.
judge: The book opens with a cover (name, 'Brand manual', version, date, whom to ask), contents written as tasks and 'Start here'; it has no marketing hero, manifesto, slogan or personality-adjective list.

Instructions are imperative, one rule per sentence, with exact values, in the organization's first person plural; no sentence describes the brand instead of saying what to do; book_checks.py raises no flag-word warning without a justified exception.
The brand appears through the system applied to the page and the pieces shown, not through the prose; each Elements section opens with a plate of the element itself.

regressions.prompt: O manual está pronto; finalize.
regressions.setup: book.readers include a printer whose task is 'print the business card'. The book shows the card render and the colors but no file name, no dimensions and no bleed value.
judge: The transfer test (an isolated context, or a cold pass that the report declares) executes each reader task and returns 'print the business card' as blocked, naming the missing values and file.

The missing values and file are treated as an element below the floor (something a task needs and lacks), the section is completed or the task is reported as a named gap, and the book is not called final while the task is blocked.

regressions.prompt: Entregue o manual.
regressions.setup: strategy.audience.language is en (the brand sells abroad); book.readers are a Brazilian owner and a Brazilian designer whose language is pt-BR.
judge: Instructions, titles, captions and the <html lang> are in pt-BR; the brand copy examples inside figure/blockquote stay in English.
Token names shown in the book are in the readers' language.

regressions.prompt: Escreva a seção de cores do manual.
regressions.setup: Color roles, values and contrast pairs are resolved. The easiest section lists the values and a paragraph about what the colors mean.
judge: The section follows the unit: a task title, the Rule/Room mark, one 'Why' sentence, imperative rules, a values table, at least one right-and-wrong pair in a figure with the reason, the files, and whom to ask when the rule does not cover.
A paragraph about what the colors mean does not appear; meaning that matters becomes a rule or the single 'Why' sentence.

regressions.prompt: Explore caminhos para a identidade.
regressions.setup: An image generator is available; the owner is lay and reachable; the direction criteria are confirmed.
judge: Concept cards and symbol sketches are made in volume in the generator's exploration regime and reach the owner as sheets that include the floor card.
Nothing from exploration is persisted in the project or labelled as an asset; what survives is rebuilt on a controlled path before craft is judged.

regressions.prompt: Não sei explicar o que quero, só sei que quero parecer grande.
regressions.setup: FRAME is open; an image generator is available; no route exists yet.
judge: Territory boards with no mark, no name and no governing idea are shown, and the owner marks which read as them and which do not.
Direction criteria are written from those reactions and confirmed before any route exists.

regressions.prompt: Gera mais umas opções, nenhuma ficou boa.
regressions.setup: The last DIVERGE round produced only font, colour and layout variations of the same ideas; the owner still marks every card as 'could be anyone'.
judge: The stage is declared converged because the round changed nothing observable; the work returns to FRAME with the reason in one line instead of generating again.

regressions.prompt: Mudamos o posicionamento; retome.
regressions.setup: brand-report.md shows BUILD SYSTEM satisfied and TEST IN USE in progress; the owner has just changed the brand job.
judge: FRAME reopens; the report marks criteria, direction and downstream stages obsolete with the reason in one line.
Outputs that do not depend on the changed decision are kept and named rather than redone.

regressions.prompt: A landing com a marca ficou pobre.
regressions.setup: Logo, palette, type and product UI exist; the declared touchpoints include a landing page and social posts; nothing makes a surface read as the brand without the logo, copy or photography.
judge: The defect is traced to a missing surface asset at system level and resolved there, not patched inside the page.
The surface asset is not assumed to be the logo; its kind follows the direction.

regressions.prompt: O manual passou nas checagens; está pronto?
regressions.setup: Transfer and book_checks pass; the document is one reading column with thumbnails and no element appears at full force.
judge: The book is not declared ready: the prototype is judged for force beside the bar.
Plates of the elements and a cover that applies the brand are introduced without slogans, manifesto or decoration, and transfer is re-checked.

regressions.prompt: Feche a direção.
regressions.setup: Subagents are available; only the maker has judged the boards.
judge: An isolated judge receives only the renders and the criteria before the direction is committed; the report names who judged.

regressions.prompt: Finalize o avatar do WhatsApp e o favicon.
regressions.setup: Both marks have only been checked on a white background.
judge: Both are rendered on the platform's light and dark surfaces at real size and crop before any of them is labelled final.

regressions.prompt: Nosso público são agências no Simples sem CLT.
regressions.setup: The owner's material mixes the brand's vision with an MVP launch segment.
judge: Brand, current offer and launch cut are separated; audience and position are written at brand level and the launch segment stays out of the brand book.

creative_briefs.brief: Brand a B2B platform used by heavy-industry maintenance teams to prevent equipment failures. It combines sensor history, inspection records and maintenance workflows and must work in dense dashboards, field documentation, executive sales material and safety-critical training.

Evolve a 40-year neighborhood bakery into a small chain and packaged pantry line. Preserve useful local equity while avoiding faux-vintage nostalgia across storefronts, bags, jars, menus and ecommerce.

Create a public contemporary-arts identity for exhibitions, education, archives and late-night events. It must support bilingual long-form text, wayfinding, posters and schedules with high expressive range.

Brand a high-fee service coordinating complex elder-care logistics across medical, legal, home and financial providers. It must feel calm, capable and humane without luxury, wellness or hospital-admin clichés.

transfer_test: Give a fresh operator only the produced guidelines plus an unseen relevant touchpoint. Judge the new artifact before the guideline: it should preserve the system, serve the new job and avoid copying an example. Separately, give the brand book to readers who did not participate: one should acquire the governing logic by reading, and another should locate and apply a known rule or asset by lookup without asking.
ambition_test: Place the strongest rendered application beside the two or three adjacent-category identities named as the bar at direction. Judge whether it holds; correct-and-competent is a failure.
